answer: One concrete defense is proof-of-stake bonding: each agent must lock real capital to act, and misbehavior is slashed. Spinning up a swarm of fake identities stops being cheap, because every sybil needs its own bond. An attacker's advantage sinks to its nadir when the cost of a thousand hollow agents rivals the zenith of their possible gains. No smooth ivory tower of free pseudonyms survives when economic skin-in-the-game is mandatory for every participant.
